notes: Cash-basis village. Governmental data from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Totals 2025 column (pp5-6: left columns p5, totals p6). Bond principal 60,000 and interest/fees 4,845 are printed below total expenditures (other financing uses) and recorded as disbursements outside_printed_total. Transfers in/out 262,317 each (net zero). Identity: 1,073,567 + 650,301 - 407,710 - 60,000 - 4,845 + 262,317 - 262,317 = 1,251,313. Taxes 317,529 split using p10 major-fund columns (property 101,054, motor vehicle 11,511, sales 29,095+119,072); Debt Service fund taxes 56,797 and intergovernmental 11,845 are printed only as totals in the Debt Service column (p5), not broken down by type. Intergovernmental 108,008 split: highway allocation 70,388, motor vehicle fees 4,697 (as motor vehicle tax), Homestead allocation 7,669 (Homestead Exemption, attempt 2), other 13,409, debt service 11,845. Statement 'Debt service' 613 (Debt Service fund, not split into principal/interest) recorded as debt service (principal and interest combined) (attempt 2). Zero-valued printed lines (insurance proceeds, grant income/donations) omitted. Business-type: Exhibit H (p8) total column; no single printed total so receipts = operating receipts 200,343 + interest 189 and disbursements = operating 231,330 + interest expense 5,355 (computed); net position 1,056,833 + 200,532 - 236,685 = 1,020,680. Capital asset purchases 362,428 and debt proceeds 278,745 (cash flow statement p9) are not in the net position statement and are not part of the roll-forward. proprietary left null (modified cash basis, not GAAP). Detail: major governmental funds p10, nonmajor combining per fund (8 funds, p11-12), Water/Sewer from Exhibit H by fund; Schedule 5 budget summary (p13) and Schedule 6 (p14) are totals only and not repeated. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals 2025 column (p1), kept because it includes capital assets and long-term debt. Outside-review fix: nonmajor combining detail rebuilt per fund (pp11-12) so functions match Exhibit E; Miscellaneous 5,262 split 4,269 Street (charges) / 993 other; proprietary non-operating interest lines added to detail (outside_printed_total).
